name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd
about: HDFC Life Insurance Company is engaged in carrying on the business of life insurance. The Company offers a range of individual and group insurance solutions. The portfolio comprises of various insurance and investment products such as Protection, Pension, Savings,(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No: 175)
keyPoints:
Parentage
HDFC Bank Ltd (HBL), the promoter group, holds a 50.3% stake as of Q3 FY25. As India’s largest private sector bank by balance sheet size, HBL and its subsidiaries offer a wide array of financial services, including non-banking financial services, insurance, asset management, and broking.
